semanticDecisions: one grading for every lane (64, 256, 1024, 4096 units): an early exit reads at most 64 units, the second and third reads stay small, and the steady state keeps the window the lanes were measured with
windows are allocated per size step, not per call at the steady-state size, so a short comparison allocates 64 units at most
the flat-needle lanes never read less than twice the needle, so every window holds at least one full candidate and the overlap rule of A27 holds
the content coder scan (A22) joins the grading because the A28 content-coder check runs it on every case-insensitive compare of a UTF-16 range
